hwitems.description: List of hardware items to probe (e.g., disk, cpu, network). Must be present to trigger probing.

log_file.description: Path to the file where log info is written.

verbose.description: Increase verbosity. Only together with --map, but included as a config flag.

device_filters.description: List of device names (DEVNAME) to filter output for. Must be used with --hwitems.

save_config_target.description: Device name, UDI, or 'all' to store config for. Stored below /var/lib/hardware.
